def f(gin):
    h,w=len(gin),len(gin[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in gin for v in row)
    bgn,ln=cnt.most_common(2)[0][0],cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]
    seeds=[(r,c,gin[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gin[r][c] not in (bgn,ln)]
    out=[row[:] for row in gin]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if gin[r][c]==ln:
                best=None
                for sr,sc,scol in seeds:
                    d=abs(sr-r)+abs(sc-c); par=d%2
                    k=(d,par,scol)
                    if best is None or k<best: best=k
                best=best[2] if best else None
                out[r][c]=best
    return out
